title: Hom. 2: Zacharias and Elizabeth righteous (Luke 1:6)
english: On [[they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments >> Bible:Luke 1:6]]: righteousness is not a show for people but walking blameless before God; the priestly pair models obedience without which the forerunner’s birth is not understood.

title: Hom. 3: Angel at the incense hour (Luke 1:8-11)
english: While Zacharias serves in the [[order of his course >> Bible:Luke 1:8]] and offers incense, the angel appears. Prayer and temple service meet revelation; fear is fitting when heaven speaks in the holy place.

title: Hom. 4: John’s name and father’s silence (Luke 1:13-20)
english: [[Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John >> Bible:Luke 1:13]]. Unbelief seals the tongue; faith will open it. The name and the silence preach that God’s word stands whether we trust it or not.
